title: Are you the next myki-angelo?
articleDescription: You might have heard that under 18s now travel free on all public transport with a Youth myki.
articleContent:
Last year, 11-year-old Charlie took out the top design in the Youth myki Design competition, and you can see his design on all Youth myki’s today.

We’re on the lookout for the next Youth myki design!

Submit your design and tell us about what inspired it - your artwork could be featured on the next Youth myki AND you could win a $1,000 prize!

Three designs will be shortlisted and voting will open to the public – the design with the most votes will be chosen as the new Youth myki design for 2027.

Entries are now open and close 11.59pm, 2 August 2026. 

 

Get creative and enter now!
